answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 6985 Country: India Title: I have a question regarding congretional dua after every fard prayer and collective dua. Is it biddah or what. please clarify. Question: I have a question regarding congretional dua after every fard prayer and collective dua. Is it biddah or what. please clarify. Answer ID: 6985 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1319/1238=D/1429) Supplicating after performing obligatory salah is proved by the Hadith and it is also narrated that the supplication is a virtuous thing. The people should supplicate individually; however it is not wrong if it looks like congregational. If someone ends the prayer earlier while the other prays a bit longer, it is also not wrong, it is allowed. By ?congregational? if you mean some other method, then you should explain it. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
